run_throw_on_failure_test: run the googletest throw-on-failure test suite to verify assertion failure exit codes
test_throw_on_failure_env_var: test the GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable by setting it to 0 or 1
test_throw_on_failure_flag: test the --gtest_throw_on_failure command line flag to enable or disable throw mode
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_throw_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable
set_env_var: set or unset an environment variable using SetEnvVar with a name and value
